Bitwise Survey: Crypto Allocations Among Institutions Are Mostly 1%–2%, With None of 15 Interviewed Cutting Exposure During a 50% Market Decline

Bitwise interviewed investment professionals at 15 endowments, pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, family offices and public companies between late March and April 2026.

All crypto-owning respondents held Bitcoin. Crypto allocations ranged from 0.5% to 13% of investable assets, with most between 1% and 2%. None reduced exposure as the crypto market fell roughly 50% between October 2025 and April 2026, while several added to their positions.
